name: Shadow The Hedgehog
source:
Shadow has found out that Sonic got himself a human girlfriend! Now it's up to YOU to help him find one too! Join Shadow on this quick adventure of romance with multiple endings to discover!

[From [url=https://shibaya.itch.io/shadow-the-hedgehog]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夏特发现索尼克交了一个人类女友！现在就由你来帮他也找一位女友吧！和夏特一起展开这段短暂的恋爱冒险，探索多个结局！

[来源：[url=https://shibaya.itch.io/shadow-the-hedgehog]itch.io[/url]]
